_comment: Default bilingual abuse list for the messaging content filter. Matching folds case, diacritics, Arabic letter variants and stretched letters, and works on whole words (Arabic prefixes/suffixes allowed). Words that are also legitimate trade vocabulary (e.g. dog, donkey, garbage, retarder, bastard file) are only listed as insulting phrases. Override with FF_MESSAGING_ABUSE_TERMS / FF_MESSAGING_ABUSE_TERMS_EXTRA.
